text.joinLine: {user} has stepped out of the light.
text.title: A new shadow has awakened
text.lore: We work from the shadows. Learn our ways, pick your path, then go make some noise.
text.footer: Hide in the shadows, rise in the garden
text.goodbyeLine: Their shadow fades, but the garden remembers.
